name: Hex General
author: Eduard G. Castelló
description: A hex-grid turn-based WWII operational wargame in the spirit of the classic 1990s Panzer General. Single battles only; ships with the Ardennes, Winter 1944 scenario (the Battle of the Bulge): cross the river line, take the towns, beat the Allied reinforcements to the clock. Zones of control, entrenchment, terrain odds, artillery, a rule-based Allied AI. Open it with: omarchy-shell shell toggle eduard.hex-general (bind that to a key, or add a row to your Omarchy menu). Esc closes; the battle in progress is kept until you press New Game.
